Comment: IS459 G2T1 AML pipeline: lock, ingest external rates, crawl, ETL, then BQ1 corridors, BQ1 graph and BQ2 (gated sequences, then lift) in parallel, then the BQ1 priority list.

PipelineLock.Comment: Role 1: one pipeline execution at a time (fails fast if an earlier one is running)

FetchRates.Comment: Role 1: Lambda pulls ECB FX and Coinbase BTC into s3://is459-g2t1-aml-bucket/fx and /btc

StartRatesCrawler.Comment: Role 1: refresh raw_fx and raw_btc tables

ETL_TransactionsClean.Comment: Role 2: Glue job builds transactions_clean (Parquet) and updates the catalog. Fails on purpose if data quality checks fail.

Analytics.Comment: BQ1 corridors, BQ1 graph (Role 4) and BQ2 run in parallel once transactions_clean exists

BQ1_ResetOutputs.Comment: Role 1 helper: drop the 4 BQ1 tables and empty their S3 folders so CTAS can rerun

BQ1_Step1_and_2a.Comment: Role 3: steps 1 and 2a are independent, run together

BQ1_DirectCorridors.Comment: Role 3 step 1: direct cross-bank corridor totals

Parameters.QueryString:
CREATE TABLE is459_g2t1_aml.bq1_direct_corridors
WITH (
  format = 'PARQUET',
  external_location = 's3://is459-g2t1-aml-processed-bucket/bq1_direct_corridors/'
) AS
SELECT
  from_bank,
  to_bank,
  SUM(CASE WHEN is_laundering = 1 THEN amount_paid_usd ELSE 0 END) AS direct_laundered_usd,
  SUM(amount_paid_usd) AS direct_total_usd,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN is_laundering = 1 THEN 1 END) AS direct_laundering_txns,
  COUNT(*) AS direct_total_txns
FROM is459_g2t1_aml.transactions_clean
WHERE dataset = 'HI-Medium'
  AND cross_bank = 1
  AND amount_paid_usd < 20000000
GROUP BY from_bank, to_bank

BQ1_AttemptBanks.Comment: Role 3 step 2a: per-attempt totals and banks touched

Parameters.QueryString:
CREATE TABLE is459_g2t1_aml.bq1_attempt_banks
WITH (
  format = 'PARQUET',
  external_location = 's3://is459-g2t1-aml-processed-bucket/bq1_attempt_banks/'
) AS
SELECT
  attempt_id,
  SUM(amount_paid_usd) AS attempt_total_usd,
  ARRAY_DISTINCT(ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT from_bank) || ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT to_bank)) AS banks_touched
FROM is459_g2t1_aml.transactions_clean
WHERE dataset = 'HI-Medium'
  AND is_laundering = 1
  AND attempt_id IS NOT NULL
  AND amount_paid_usd < 20000000
GROUP BY attempt_id

BQ1_SharedAttemptValue.Comment: Role 3 step 2b: shared attempt value per bank pair

Parameters.QueryString:
CREATE TABLE is459_g2t1_aml.bq1_shared_attempt_value
WITH (
  format = 'PARQUET',
  external_location = 's3://is459-g2t1-aml-processed-bucket/bq1_shared_attempt_value/'
) AS
SELECT
  a.bank_x AS from_bank,
  b.bank_y AS to_bank,
  SUM(t.attempt_total_usd) AS shared_attempt_value_usd
FROM is459_g2t1_aml.bq1_attempt_banks t
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(t.banks_touched) AS a(bank_x)
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(t.banks_touched) AS b(bank_y)
WHERE a.bank_x != b.bank_y
GROUP BY a.bank_x, b.bank_y

BQ1_CorridorsRanked.Comment: Role 3 step 3: final ranked corridors (extra laundering value, blindspot gap)

Parameters.QueryString:
CREATE TABLE is459_g2t1_aml.bq1_corridors_ranked
WITH (
  format = 'PARQUET',
  external_location = 's3://is459-g2t1-aml-processed-bucket/bq1_corridors_ranked/'
) AS
SELECT
  d.from_bank,
  d.to_bank,
  d.direct_laundered_usd,
  COALESCE(s.shared_attempt_value_usd, 0) AS total_laundering_in_path_usd,
  GREATEST(COALESCE(s.shared_attempt_value_usd, 0) - d.direct_laundered_usd, 0) AS extra_laundering_value_usd,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.shared_attempt_value_usd, 0) > 0
    THEN GREATEST(COALESCE(s.shared_attempt_value_usd, 0) - d.direct_laundered_usd, 0)
         / CAST(s.shared_attempt_value_usd AS DOUBLE)
    ELSE 0 END AS blindspot_gap
FROM is459_g2t1_aml.bq1_direct_corridors d
LEFT JOIN is459_g2t1_aml.bq1_shared_attempt_value s
  ON d.from_bank = s.from_bank AND d.to_bank = s.to_bank

Graph_Init.Comment: Role 4: fresh run ID per execution (runner rejects reused IDs)

Graph_StartInstance.Comment: Only starts the instance if it was stopped; remembers this so it is stopped again afterwards

Graph_WaitForNeo4j.Comment: Fresh boot: give Docker/Neo4j time to start before the runner connects

Graph_RunGraph.Comment: Role 4: run the graph runner via her SSM document

Graph_ReadReceipt.Comment: Validate the run-specific success.json the runner publishes last

Graph_UpdateLatestView.Comment: Stable name for Role 3 / Tableau: points at this run's validated feature table

Parameters.QueryString.$: States.Format('CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW is459_g2t1_aml.bq1_graph_bank_features_latest AS SELECT * FROM {}', $.graph.receipt.receipt.feature_table)

Graph_CleanupOnFailure.Comment: On any failure: stop the instance only if this run started it

Graph_Failed.Cause: Role 4 graph run failed: see the failed step, SSM command output, or bq1_graph_results/<runId>/ in S3

BQ2_Plan.Comment: Role 5: find the live copy (A or B) and plan the build into the other one

BQ2_SourceBefore.Comment: Gate: transactions_clean complete (exact rows, unique ids, every day) and fingerprint its files

BQ2_ResetTarget.Comment: Drop and empty the copy being built (refuses if it is live)

BQ2_BuildDays.Comment: Build and gate each dataset-day, 5 at a time. Any failed day stops the run before publish

Day_Triples.Comment: Insert this day's triples (after pairs, so the partition is created once)

Day_Count.Comment: Gate: stored pairs and triples = fresh recount from transactions_clean

Day_Lineage.Comment: Gate: every member in the source, attributes match, every link valid (one pass)

BQ2_Structure.Comment: Gate: every derived column of every row recomputed

BQ2_SourceAfter.Comment: Gate: source still complete and unchanged during the build

BQ2_SourceChanged.CausePath: States.Format('transactions_clean changed during the build. Before: {} After: {}', $.bq2.src_before.fingerprint, States.JsonToString($.bq2.src_after.row))

BQ2_Publish.Comment: Switch the bq2_sequences view to the new copy (the old copy stays as rollback)

BQ2_Done.Comment: Keep only a small summary for the rest of the pipeline

BQ2_Lift_Reset.Comment: Role 6: drop the 5 Role 6 tables and empty their folders so the chain can rerun

Parameters.QueryString:
-- bq2 lift lift
CREATE TABLE is459_g2t1_aml.bq2_lift
WITH (
  format = 'PARQUET',
  external_location = 's3://is459-g2t1-aml-processed-bucket/bq2_lift/'
) AS
WITH cutoffs (min_support) AS (VALUES (50), (100), (500)),
counts AS (
  SELECT dataset, method_sequence, sequence_length,
         COUNT(*) AS support_count, SUM(any_laundering) AS laundering_count
  FROM is459_g2t1_aml.bq2_sequences
  WHERE dataset IN ('HI-Medium', 'LI-Medium')
  GROUP BY dataset, method_sequence, sequence_length
), totals AS (
  SELECT dataset, sequence_length, SUM(support_count) AS total_sequences,
         SUM(laundering_count) AS total_laundering_sequences
  FROM counts GROUP BY dataset, sequence_length
), rates AS (
  SELECT c.*, k.min_support, t.total_sequences, t.total_laundering_sequences,
         CAST(c.laundering_count AS DOUBLE) / c.support_count AS laundering_rate,
         CAST(t.total_laundering_sequences AS DOUBLE) / t.total_sequences AS baseline_rate,
         CAST(c.support_count AS DOUBLE) / t.total_sequences AS support_share,
         CASE WHEN c.support_count >= k.min_support THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS eligible
  FROM counts c JOIN totals t ON c.dataset = t.dataset AND c.sequence_length = t.sequence_length
  CROSS JOIN cutoffs k
), scored AS (
  SELECT *, laundering_rate / NULLIF(baseline_rate, 0) AS lift FROM rates
)
SELECT *, CASE WHEN eligible = 1 AND lift IS NOT NULL THEN
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY dataset, sequence_length, min_support
    ORDER BY eligible DESC, lift DESC, laundering_count DESC,
             support_count DESC, method_sequence, sequence_length
  ) END AS risk_rank
FROM scored

-- bq2 lift flagged_hi2
CREATE TABLE is459_g2t1_aml.bq2_tradeoff_flagged
WITH (
  format = 'PARQUET',
  external_location = 's3://is459-g2t1-aml-processed-bucket/bq2_tradeoff_flagged/'
) AS
WITH ranks AS (
  SELECT min_support, method_sequence, MIN(risk_rank) AS risk_rank
  FROM is459_g2t1_aml.bq2_lift
  WHERE dataset = 'HI-Medium' AND sequence_length = 2 AND risk_rank <= 10
  GROUP BY min_support, method_sequence
), patterns AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT method_sequence FROM ranks
), matched AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.method_sequence, s.final_txn_id
  FROM is459_g2t1_aml.bq2_sequences s
  JOIN patterns p ON p.method_sequence = s.method_sequence
  WHERE s.dataset = 'HI-Medium' AND s.sequence_length = 2
)
SELECT 'HI-Medium' AS dataset, CAST(2 AS integer) AS sequence_length, r.min_support,
       m.final_txn_id, MIN(r.risk_rank) AS best_rank
FROM matched m JOIN ranks r ON r.method_sequence = m.method_sequence
GROUP BY r.min_support, m.final_txn_id

-- bq2 lift flagged_hi3
INSERT INTO is459_g2t1_aml.bq2_tradeoff_flagged
WITH ranks AS (
  SELECT min_support, method_sequence, MIN(risk_rank) AS risk_rank
  FROM is459_g2t1_aml.bq2_lift
  WHERE dataset = 'HI-Medium' AND sequence_length = 3 AND risk_rank <= 10
  GROUP BY min_support, method_sequence
), patterns AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT method_sequence FROM ranks
), matched AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.method_sequence, s.final_txn_id
  FROM is459_g2t1_aml.bq2_sequences s
  JOIN patterns p ON p.method_sequence = s.method_sequence
  WHERE s.dataset = 'HI-Medium' AND s.sequence_length = 3
)
SELECT 'HI-Medium' AS dataset, CAST(3 AS integer) AS sequence_length, r.min_support,
       m.final_txn_id, MIN(r.risk_rank) AS best_rank
FROM matched m JOIN ranks r ON r.method_sequence = m.method_sequence
GROUP BY r.min_support, m.final_txn_id

-- bq2 lift flagged_li2
INSERT INTO is459_g2t1_aml.bq2_tradeoff_flagged
WITH ranks AS (
  SELECT min_support, method_sequence, MIN(risk_rank) AS risk_rank
  FROM is459_g2t1_aml.bq2_lift
  WHERE dataset = 'HI-Medium' AND sequence_length = 2 AND risk_rank <= 10
  GROUP BY min_support, method_sequence
), patterns AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT method_sequence FROM ranks
), matched AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.method_sequence, s.final_txn_id
  FROM is459_g2t1_aml.bq2_sequences s
  JOIN patterns p ON p.method_sequence = s.method_sequence
  WHERE s.dataset = 'LI-Medium' AND s.sequence_length = 2
)
SELECT 'LI-Medium' AS dataset, CAST(2 AS integer) AS sequence_length, r.min_support,
       m.final_txn_id, MIN(r.risk_rank) AS best_rank
FROM matched m JOIN ranks r ON r.method_sequence = m.method_sequence
GROUP BY r.min_support, m.final_txn_id

-- bq2 lift flagged_li3
INSERT INTO is459_g2t1_aml.bq2_tradeoff_flagged
WITH ranks AS (
  SELECT min_support, method_sequence, MIN(risk_rank) AS risk_rank
  FROM is459_g2t1_aml.bq2_lift
  WHERE dataset = 'HI-Medium' AND sequence_length = 3 AND risk_rank <= 10
  GROUP BY min_support, method_sequence
), patterns AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT method_sequence FROM ranks
), matched AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.method_sequence, s.final_txn_id
  FROM is459_g2t1_aml.bq2_sequences s
  JOIN patterns p ON p.method_sequence = s.method_sequence
  WHERE s.dataset = 'LI-Medium' AND s.sequence_length = 3
)
SELECT 'LI-Medium' AS dataset, CAST(3 AS integer) AS sequence_length, r.min_support,
       m.final_txn_id, MIN(r.risk_rank) AS best_rank
FROM matched m JOIN ranks r ON r.method_sequence = m.method_sequence
GROUP BY r.min_support, m.final_txn_id

-- bq2 lift tradeoff
CREATE TABLE is459_g2t1_aml.bq2_tradeoff
WITH (
  format = 'PARQUET',
  external_location = 's3://is459-g2t1-aml-processed-bucket/bq2_tradeoff/'
) AS
WITH policies (policy, top_n) AS (
  VALUES ('Targeted top-3', 3), ('Targeted top-5', 5),
         ('Targeted top-10', 10), ('Broad: review all', 0)
), lengths (sequence_length) AS (VALUES (2), (3)),
cutoffs (min_support) AS (VALUES (50), (100), (500)),
selected AS (
  SELECT p.policy, p.top_n, l.min_support, l.method_sequence, l.sequence_length
  FROM policies p JOIN is459_g2t1_aml.bq2_lift l
    ON l.dataset = 'HI-Medium' AND l.risk_rank <= p.top_n
), selected_counts AS (
  SELECT policy, sequence_length, min_support, COUNT(*) AS actual_patterns
  FROM selected GROUP BY policy, sequence_length, min_support
), flagged AS (
  SELECT dataset, sequence_length, min_support, final_txn_id, MIN(best_rank) AS best_rank
  FROM is459_g2t1_aml.bq2_tradeoff_flagged
  GROUP BY dataset, sequence_length, min_support, final_txn_id
), by_rank AS (
  SELECT f.dataset, f.sequence_length, f.min_support, f.best_rank,
         COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(t.is_laundering) AS n_laundering, SUM(1 - t.is_laundering) AS n_legitimate
  FROM flagged f JOIN is459_g2t1_aml.transactions_clean t
    ON t.dataset = f.dataset AND t.txn_id = f.final_txn_id
  WHERE t.dataset IN ('HI-Medium', 'LI-Medium')
  GROUP BY f.dataset, f.sequence_length, f.min_support, f.best_rank
), reviewed AS (
  SELECT b.dataset, p.policy, b.sequence_length, b.min_support,
         SUM(b.n) AS reviewed, SUM(b.n_laundering) AS laundering_flagged,
         SUM(b.n_legitimate) AS legitimate_reviewed
  FROM by_rank b JOIN policies p ON p.top_n > 0 AND b.best_rank <= p.top_n
  GROUP BY b.dataset, p.policy, b.sequence_length, b.min_support
), population AS (
  SELECT dataset, COUNT(*) AS total_transactions,
         SUM(is_laundering) AS total_laundering,
         SUM(1 - is_laundering) AS total_legitimate
  FROM is459_g2t1_aml.transactions_clean
  WHERE dataset IN ('HI-Medium', 'LI-Medium') GROUP BY dataset
), measured AS (
  SELECT t.*, p.policy, p.top_n, l.sequence_length, k.min_support,
         COALESCE(c.actual_patterns, 0) AS actual_patterns,
         CASE WHEN p.top_n = 0 THEN t.total_transactions ELSE COALESCE(r.reviewed, 0) END AS reviewed,
         CASE WHEN p.top_n = 0 THEN t.total_laundering ELSE COALESCE(r.laundering_flagged, 0) END AS laundering_flagged,
         CASE WHEN p.top_n = 0 THEN t.total_legitimate ELSE COALESCE(r.legitimate_reviewed, 0) END AS legitimate_reviewed
  FROM population t CROSS JOIN policies p CROSS JOIN lengths l CROSS JOIN cutoffs k
  LEFT JOIN reviewed r ON r.dataset = t.dataset AND r.policy = p.policy
    AND r.sequence_length = l.sequence_length AND r.min_support = k.min_support
  LEFT JOIN selected_counts c ON c.policy = p.policy
    AND c.sequence_length = l.sequence_length AND c.min_support = k.min_support
)
SELECT *,
       CAST(laundering_flagged AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(total_laundering, 0) AS laundering_catch_rate,
       CAST(legitimate_reviewed AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(total_legitimate, 0) AS legitimate_review_rate,
       CAST(reviewed AS DOUBLE) / total_transactions AS review_share,
       CAST(laundering_flagged AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(reviewed, 0) AS review_precision
FROM measured

-- bq2 lift robustness
CREATE TABLE is459_g2t1_aml.bq2_robustness
WITH (
  format = 'PARQUET',
  external_location = 's3://is459-g2t1-aml-processed-bucket/bq2_robustness/'
) AS
SELECT hi.method_sequence, hi.sequence_length, hi.min_support, hi.risk_rank AS hi_rank,
       hi.support_count AS hi_support, hi.lift AS hi_lift,
       COALESCE(li.support_count, 0) AS li_support,
       COALESCE(li.laundering_count, 0) AS li_laundering_count,
       li.laundering_rate AS li_laundering_rate, li.lift AS li_lift,
       li.risk_rank AS li_rank,
       CASE WHEN li.method_sequence IS NULL THEN 'Absent on LI'
            WHEN li.eligible = 0 THEN 'Below LI support cutoff'
            WHEN li.lift IS NULL THEN 'LI baseline has no laundering'
            ELSE 'Supported on LI' END AS li_status
FROM is459_g2t1_aml.bq2_lift hi
LEFT JOIN is459_g2t1_aml.bq2_lift li
  ON li.dataset = 'LI-Medium' AND li.method_sequence = hi.method_sequence
     AND li.sequence_length = hi.sequence_length AND li.min_support = hi.min_support
WHERE hi.dataset = 'HI-Medium' AND hi.risk_rank <= 10

-- bq2 lift sankey
CREATE TABLE is459_g2t1_aml.bq2_sankey
WITH (
  format = 'PARQUET',
  external_location = 's3://is459-g2t1-aml-processed-bucket/bq2_sankey/'
) AS
SELECT dataset, method_sequence, sequence_length,
       split_part(method_sequence, ' -> ', 1) AS method_1,
       split_part(method_sequence, ' -> ', 2) AS method_2,
       CASE WHEN sequence_length = 3
         THEN split_part(method_sequence, ' -> ', 3) END AS method_3,
       support_count AS sequence_count,
       laundering_count AS laundering_sequence_count,
       support_count - laundering_count AS legitimate_sequence_count
FROM is459_g2t1_aml.bq2_lift
WHERE min_support = 50

BQ2_Lift_Check.Comment: Gate: lift, trade-off, robustness and Sankey reconcile with bq2_sequences

Parameters.QueryString:
-- bq2 gate lift outputs
-- Run by Step Functions after the Role 6 tables are rebuilt. One row; ok must be 'true'.
-- Every count below must be 0 (or match), otherwise the run fails with this row as the cause.
-- flagged_groups = expected_flagged_groups: every (dataset, length, support) group whose HI top-10
-- patterns occur in that dataset has trade-off stage 1 rows (a missing group = a statement wrote nothing).
WITH seq AS (
  SELECT dataset, sequence_length, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(any_laundering) AS l
  FROM is459_g2t1_aml.bq2_sequences
  WHERE dataset IN ('HI-Medium', 'LI-Medium')
  GROUP BY dataset, sequence_length
), lift_totals AS (
  SELECT dataset, sequence_length, min_support,
         SUM(support_count) AS n, SUM(laundering_count) AS l,
         COUNT(risk_rank) - COUNT(DISTINCT risk_rank) AS dup_ranks
  FROM is459_g2t1_aml.bq2_lift
  GROUP BY dataset, sequence_length, min_support
), lift_check AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM seq) AS sequence_groups,
    COUNT(*) AS lift_groups,
    COUNT_IF(s.n IS NULL OR s.n <> t.n OR s.l <> t.l) AS lift_support_mismatches,
    COALESCE(SUM(t.dup_ranks), 0) AS lift_duplicate_ranks
  FROM lift_totals t LEFT JOIN seq s
    ON s.dataset = t.dataset AND s.sequence_length = t.sequence_length
), flagged_check AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS flagged_rows,
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
            SELECT DISTINCT dataset, sequence_length, min_support
            FROM is459_g2t1_aml.bq2_tradeoff_flagged) g) AS flagged_groups,
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
            SELECT DISTINCT d.dataset, h.sequence_length, h.min_support
            FROM is459_g2t1_aml.bq2_lift h
            JOIN is459_g2t1_aml.bq2_lift d
              ON d.method_sequence = h.method_sequence AND d.sequence_length = h.sequence_length
             AND d.min_support = h.min_support
            WHERE h.dataset = 'HI-Medium' AND h.risk_rank <= 10 AND d.support_count > 0) e) AS expected_flagged_groups,
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
            SELECT 1 FROM is459_g2t1_aml.bq2_tradeoff_flagged
            GROUP BY dataset, sequence_length, min_support, final_txn_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) d) AS flagged_duplicates,
         COUNT_IF(best_rank IS NULL OR best_rank NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 10) AS flagged_bad_ranks
  FROM is459_g2t1_aml.bq2_tradeoff_flagged
), tradeoff_check AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS tradeoff_rows,
         COUNT_IF(reviewed <> laundering_flagged + legitimate_reviewed
                  OR reviewed > total_transactions
                  OR laundering_flagged > total_laundering) AS tradeoff_accounting_errors
  FROM is459_g2t1_aml.bq2_tradeoff
), robustness_check AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS robustness_rows,
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM is459_g2t1_aml.bq2_lift
          WHERE dataset = 'HI-Medium' AND risk_rank <= 10) AS hi_top10_rows
  FROM is459_g2t1_aml.bq2_robustness
), sankey_check AS (
  SELECT COUNT_IF(s.n IS NULL OR s.n <> k.n OR s.l <> k.l) AS sankey_mismatches,
         COUNT(*) AS sankey_groups
  FROM (SELECT dataset, sequence_length, SUM(sequence_count) AS n, SUM(laundering_sequence_count) AS l
        FROM is459_g2t1_aml.bq2_sankey GROUP BY dataset, sequence_length) k
  LEFT JOIN seq s ON s.dataset = k.dataset AND s.sequence_length = k.sequence_length
)
SELECT CASE WHEN c.sequence_groups = 4
             AND c.lift_groups = 12
             AND c.lift_support_mismatches = 0
             AND c.lift_duplicate_ranks = 0
             AND f.expected_flagged_groups > 0 AND f.flagged_groups = f.expected_flagged_groups AND f.flagged_duplicates = 0 AND f.flagged_bad_ranks = 0
             AND t.tradeoff_rows = 48 AND t.tradeoff_accounting_errors = 0
             AND r.robustness_rows = r.hi_top10_rows AND r.robustness_rows > 0
             AND k.sankey_groups = 4 AND k.sankey_mismatches = 0
            THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END AS ok,
       c.*, f.*, t.*, r.*, k.*
FROM lift_check c CROSS JOIN flagged_check f CROSS JOIN tradeoff_check t
     CROSS JOIN robustness_check r CROSS JOIN sankey_check k

BQ1_PriorityReset.Comment: Role 1 helper: drop bq1_priority_sharing_list and empty its folder so the CTAS can rerun

BQ1_PriorityList.Comment: Role 3: final priority sharing list = ranked corridors + Role 4 graph features (_latest view)

Parameters.QueryString:
CREATE TABLE is459_g2t1_aml.bq1_priority_sharing_list
WITH (format = 'PARQUET', external_location = 's3://is459-g2t1-aml-processed-bucket/bq1_priority_sharing_list/') AS
SELECT
  r.from_bank,
  r.to_bank,
  r.direct_laundered_usd,
  r.total_laundering_in_path_usd,
  r.extra_laundering_value_usd,
  r.blindspot_gap,
  fb.betweenness AS from_bank_betweenness,
  fb.community_id AS from_bank_community,
  tb.betweenness AS to_bank_betweenness,
  tb.community_id AS to_bank_community,
  CASE WHEN fb.community_id IS NULL OR tb.community_id IS NULL THEN NULL
       WHEN fb.community_id != tb.community_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS cross_community_flag
FROM is459_g2t1_aml.bq1_corridors_ranked r
LEFT JOIN is459_g2t1_aml.bq1_graph_bank_features_latest fb ON r.from_bank = CAST(fb.bank_id AS BIGINT)
LEFT JOIN is459_g2t1_aml.bq1_graph_bank_features_latest tb ON r.to_bank = CAST(tb.bank_id AS BIGINT)

ETLFailed.Comment: Stops the pipeline so BQ1 and BQ2 never run on bad data

PipelineComplete.Comment: Tableau reads the final Athena tables
